prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
ai_overview_text:
Top-rated dental implant providers in Phoenix, Arizona, include specialized centers and highly recommended clinics depending on whether you need a single-tooth replacement or full-arch restoration:
Address: 12320 N 32nd St #3, Phoenix, AZ 85032
Lead Specialist: Dr. Joe Mehranfar, DMD (treated over 3,000 full-mouth cases, international lecturer on All-on-4® and digital workflows)
Rating: 4.9/5 (577+ reviews)
Highlights: Locally owned, features an in-house digital lab, offers same-day temporary teeth, and places permanent zirconia teeth in as little as 21 days.
Scope of Procedure: Single-tooth implants can often be handled by a skilled general or restorative dentist, whereas full-mouth reconstructions (like All-on-4) benefit from dedicated surgical teams, periodontists, or prosthodontists. AZ Dentist +1
Cost Expectations: In the Phoenix area, single-tooth implants typically range from $3,000 to $6,000 (including post, abutment, and crown), while full-arch solutions run anywhere from $18,000 to $35,000+ per arch. Always request an itemized 3D CT scan and consultation breakdown. AZ Dentist +1
Are you looking to replace a single tooth or an entire arch (multiple teeth / All-on-4), and do you have a preferred side of Phoenix?
